# Adrien Lacourpaille

> Full-stack developer in Nantes, France: websites, APIs and party games.
> TypeScript and React on the front, Node on the back.

Adrien came to code through the Site du Zéro as a teenager, spent six years in
a warehouse, retrained at O'Clock in 2021 and was hired as a developer in
Nantes in March 2023. In the evenings he builds Taverla, realtime party games
for one screen and the whole room, alone and end to end.

## Pages

Every page is served in English under `/en` and in French under `/fr`, as its
own document with its own `lang`, title and description. `/` carries no
language: it negotiates from the browser's and redirects, which is what
`hreflang="x-default"` points at.

- [Home](https://adrienlacourpaille.dev/en): who he is, and what is in the box.
- [Projects](https://adrienlacourpaille.dev/en/projects)
- [Taverla](https://adrienlacourpaille.dev/en/projects/taverla): party games on every phone in the room, on the same instant.
- [Packages](https://adrienlacourpaille.dev/en/projects/packages): the npm packages under this site and Taverla, typed as far as the compiler goes.
- [About](https://adrienlacourpaille.dev/en/about): the path into development, and the toolbox.
- [CV](https://adrienlacourpaille.dev/en/cv), also as a [designed PDF](https://adrienlacourpaille.dev/cv/adrien-lacourpaille-cv-en.pdf) and a [plain-text PDF](https://adrienlacourpaille.dev/cv/adrien-lacourpaille-cv-ats-en.pdf) that parses cleanly.
- [Contact](https://adrienlacourpaille.dev/en/contact)
